lines.text: The soul has escaped my body for the moment and left him
lines.station_part_label: Glowing NEW SINGLE Theatre Stone Facade

lines.text: on the dance floor.
He can now just be
flesh and bones, rejection and heartache hit differently when there are no
feelings afloat.
lines.station_part_label: Glowing NEW SINGLE Theatre Stone Facade

lines.text: I want my soul now to imagine my body pulsing and head
throbbing from the music and empty on
a crowded floor of sweated perfumes and temptations.

scenes.name: Strangers collide; the last one to leave

lines.text: Let's watch strangers collide and spark electric
currents that gamut the mood, a good one.
We want him to be the last one to leave,
prolonging the
bitter refraction inside the walls of an escape that few pleasures offer
us.

scenes.name: Soul over Atlantis / the open field at the equator

lines.text: Now let us put my
soul in the middle of an open field at the equator of
a planet much larger than my own
and much hotter.
Cool me down by pouring unfiltered water out of the ice bath
salted from the closest
lines.station_part_label: Central Baptism Font of Ice Water

lines.text: moons from angels of the newest religions and its joys capturing my
body transiting in a flash of
lines.station_part_label: Central Baptism Font of Ice Water

lines.text: strobe lights.
Their gracious cursor blessed me, only infinity will tell.
lines.station_part_label: Central Baptism Font of Ice Water

lines.text: Now bring my soul back
to my body to lean back, breathe in the smoke that now
fills the room and tell myself how good
it is to finally get acquainted with the night,
